data.name: CommandDescription
data.value: Generate semantic version information from Git history.

data.name: PathDescription
data.value: Path to the local Git repository.

data.name: GithubOwnerDescription
data.value: GitHub repository owner. Defaults to the GITHUB_OWNER environment variable.

data.name: GithubRepoDescription
data.value: GitHub repository name. Defaults to the GITHUB_REPO environment variable.

data.name: GithubTokenDescription
data.value: GitHub personal access token. Defaults to the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.

data.name: BranchDescription
data.value: Git branch or reference to calculate the version from.

data.name: SourceDescription

data.name: TagPrefixDescription
